summary: Iteration 6 full-stack testing. All targeted changes verified passing: About page has only 2 stats (year + performances), 'Years Strong' removed, 'View Full History' button removed, /history route deleted (renders empty content — only navbar+footer). Homepage 'Previous Performances' section renders with correct title 'Moments Worth Reliving', 1 existing YouTube video iframe, 0 gallery photos (empty). Admin /admin/videos page: login OK, sidebar Videos link present, add-video with valid YouTube URL shows 'Video added' toast, embed URL is exactly https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ, soft-delete works. Backend /api/videos: GET public 200, POST auth required (401), POST bogus URL returns 400 with 'Unsupported video URL...' detail, POST youtu.be/... returns correct embed_url, DELETE soft-deletes. Navbar shows all 5 items + lang-switcher. 7/7 backend tests pass, all frontend checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminVideos.jsx reads session_token from document.cookie manually — brittle if cookie flags change. Consider a shared auth helper (already exists as getAuth in other admin pages). Minor DRY issue.

/history route was removed from App.js but there is no explicit 404/redirect — visiting /history renders just Navbar+Footer with an empty body. Consider adding a catch-all <Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='/' replace/>}> for a better UX.
server.py is 806 lines — approaching the 700-line ceiling. Consider splitting into routers (videos, history, hero, etc.).
